# Maxey0 for Codex

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
Append distributions/codex/config.toml to ~/.codex/config.toml
```

Codex reads MCP servers from ~/.codex/config.toml. The generated fragment names the stdio entry point in this repository.

## Identity

- product `Maxey0-SuperSpace`
- MCP namespace `maxey0-ss` — every tool and resource
- distribution id `maxey0`
- version `0.3.1`
- protocol `2026-07-28`

See [the distribution matrix](../DISTRIBUTION_MATRIX.md).
